description: This file defines various tensor computation functions for pointwise operations in the Torch JIT Tensorexpr framework, including sign computation, unary operations, binary operations with optional scalar multiplication, conditionally combining binary operations, and handling tensor construction and copying.

methods.name: Tensor computeSign(const std::vector<ArgValue> & inputValues,const std::vector<ExprHandle> & outputShape,const std::optional<std::vector<ExprHandle>> & outputStrides)
methods.description: Computes the sign of the input tensor, returning -1, 0, or 1 depending on the sign of each element.

methods.name: Tensor computeOneOperand(const std::string & name,const std::vector<ArgValue> & inputValues,const std::vector<ExprHandle> & outputShape,const std::vector<ExprHandle> & outputStrides,const std::optional<ScalarType> & outputType,const std::function<ExprHandle (const ExprHandle &)> & innerExpr,const int checkParamTypes)
methods.description: Creates a tensor by applying a unary operation specified by innerExpr on the input tensor.

methods.name: Tensor computeTwoOperand(const std::string & name,const std::vector<ArgValue> & inputValues,const std::vector<ExprHandle> & outputShape,const std::vector<ExprHandle> & outputStrides,const std::optional<ScalarType> & outputType,const std::function<ExprHandle (const ExprHandle &,const ExprHandle &)> & innerExpr)
methods.description: Creates a tensor by applying a binary operation specified by innerExpr on two input tensors.

methods.name: Tensor computeTwoOperandWithAlpha(const std::string & name,const std::vector<ArgValue> & inputValues,const std::vector<ExprHandle> & outputShape,const std::vector<ExprHandle> & outputStrides,const std::optional<ScalarType> & outputType,const std::function<ExprHandle (const ExprHandle &,const ExprHandle &)> & innerExpr)
methods.description: Creates a tensor by applying a binary operation with an additional scalar multiplier (alpha) specified by innerExpr.

methods.name: Tensor computeConditionWithTwoOperand(const std::string & name,const std::vector<ArgValue> & inputValues,const std::vector<ExprHandle> & outputShape,const std::vector<ExprHandle> & outputStrides,const std::optional<ScalarType> & outputType,const std::function<ExprHandle (const ExprHandle &,const ExprHandle &,const ExprHandle &)> & innerExpr)
methods.description: Creates a tensor based on a conditional binary operation involving a condition tensor and two operand tensors.

methods.name: Tensor computeThreeOperand(const std::string & name,const std::vector<ArgValue> & inputValues,const std::vector<ExprHandle> & outputShape,const std::vector<ExprHandle> & outputStrides,const std::optional<ScalarType> & outputType,const std::function<ExprHandle (const ExprHandle &,const ExprHandle &,const ExprHandle &)> & innerExpr,bool promote_inputs)
methods.description: Creates a tensor by applying a ternary operation specified by innerExpr on three input tensors, with optional input promotion.

methods.name: Tensor computeFourOperand(const std::string & name,const std::vector<ArgValue> & inputValues,const std::vector<ExprHandle> & outputShape,const std::vector<ExprHandle> & outputStrides,const std::optional<ScalarType> & outputType,const std::function<ExprHandle (const ExprHandle &,const ExprHandle &,const ExprHandle &,const ExprHandle &)> & innerExpr)
methods.description: Creates a tensor by applying a four-operand operation specified by innerExpr.

methods.name: Tensor computeNoop(const std::vector<ArgValue> & inputValues,const std::vector<ExprHandle> & outputShape,const std::vector<ExprHandle> & outputStrides,const std::optional<ScalarType> & outputType,at::Device device)
methods.description: Performs a no-operation copy of the input tensor.

methods.name: Tensor computeScalar(const std::string & name,const std::vector<ArgValue> & inputValues,const std::vector<ExprHandle> & outputShape,const std::vector<ExprHandle> & outputStrides,const std::optional<ScalarType> & outputType,const std::function<ExprHandle (const ExprHandle &,const ExprHandle &)> & innerExpr)
methods.description: Creates a scalar tensor by applying a binary inner operation on two scalar inputs.
